verdict.rationale: The pack documents only data-collection controls: prompt and response capture is off by default, and there are `include_prompts`, `data_collection`, and `recordInputs`/`recordOutputs` toggles. Those govern what gets captured, not how long it is kept or how it is deleted, so they are adjacent controls. Nothing in the pack covers retention periods, retention configuration, or deletion of stored data. Community notes about self-hosting describe a user-side arrangement, not a product retention or deletion feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
